fact_check.claim: Community Work-Study places about 250 students a year in local positions
fact_check.note: Page says an average of about 250 students per academic year.

fact_check.claim: Fields: arts, K-12 education, environmental programs, health, legal services, older adults, public works, women's organizations, youth programs
fact_check.note: Matches the page's list.

fact_check.claim: Current postings: Catholic Charities clothing closet assistant, YMCA lifeguard/swim instructor, History Center docent and communications roles, The Cherry Arts production associate
fact_check.note: All listed on the page (page also lists Finger Lakes ReUse). Article correctly says postings change.

fact_check.claim: Requirements: I-9 on file, FWS eligibility confirmed in Workday, full-time registration, no university holds; EEE does not subsidize wages
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: FWS covers at least 75% of wages (community work-study)
fact_check.note: Page: at least 75%; off-campus 75-100%.

fact_check.claim: America Reads / America Counts, pre-K through 9th grade, FWS covers 100% of wages
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Program suggests 15 to 20 hours a week in the academic year
fact_check.note: Page: strongly suggested 15-20 hours.

fact_check.claim: Timesheets through Workday every two weeks, due by noon Wednesday
fact_check.note: Page: due by noon every other Wednesday. 'Through Workday' not stated in the fetched summary but minor.

fact_check.claim: No vacation or holiday pay; NY paid sick leave 1 hour per 30 worked, up to 56 hours a year
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Over 40 hours/week paid at 1.5x and billed to the employer
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Give two weeks' notice; questions to cwsp@cornell.edu
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: The page says no information sessions are currently scheduled
fact_check.note: Not found in the fetched content of the page.

fact_check.claim: Universities do not count as a community; remote positions need Remote Work Arrangement form and must be in the U.S.
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: SCL lists Community Work-Study; Workday positions note work-study eligibility, pay range, dates, weekly hours
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Most units hire in spring or summer for fall; some always hiring
fact_check.note: Quoted nearly verbatim on the page.

fact_check.claim: On-campus jobs live in Workday, 'searched with your NetID'
fact_check.note: Page says log in to Workday with NetID and password, then search 'Find Jobs - student'. NetID is the login, not the search.

fact_check.claim: Cornell suggests Collegetown and Commons businesses as an option
fact_check.note: Page: 'look off-campus in the Ithaca community, perhaps in Collegetown or in the Commons.'

fact_check.claim: Chamber board shows banquet server and operational staff at Ithaca Downtown Conference Center as part-time roles
fact_check.note: Banquet Server is posted 05/13/2025 (18 months old, likely closed); 'operational staff' not found. Pay not listed.

fact_check.claim: Hotel Ithaca night auditor and shuttle van driver, from $16 an hour
fact_check.note: Both 'from $16/hour'. Night auditor is part-time or full-time (posted 10/08/2026); shuttle van driver posted 04/22/2026, type not stated, so 'part-time or flexible' is not supported for it.

fact_check.claim: Hotel night auditor at a Marriott property, $18 an hour
fact_check.note: Fairfield Inn & Suites by Marriott, $18/hour, posted 08/26/2026; part-time not stated.

fact_check.claim: Part-time valet role at Canopy by Hilton
fact_check.note: Valet Driver, full-time and part-time, 'competitive hourly pay + tips'. A Valet Supervisor at $21-$22 is also listed.

fact_check.claim: Board filters by Downtown Ithaca, City of Ithaca and categories food and restaurants, hotel and leisure, event management, non-profit
fact_check.note: Location filters seen (City of Ithaca, Downtown Ithaca BID, Tompkins County); category names seen include Food Industry and Restaurants and Hotel, Gaming, Leisure, and Travel; event management and non-profit not confirmed.

fact_check.claim: Students in first year of a degree program get unlimited TCAT rides automatically; privileges end Aug 31 (fall entrants) and Dec 31 (spring entrants)
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Registered degree students can ride free after 6 p.m. weekdays and all day on weekends
fact_check.note: Matches (listed for students 1+ year).

fact_check.claim: OmniRide pass costs $200 a year, prorated monthly, bought at MyParking.Cornell.Edu; PhD students and graduate assistants get free passes
fact_check.note: Page says $200/year prorated monthly, myparking.cornell.edu, free for PhD students and graduate assistants. The phrase 'general annual rate' and 'current price shown at purchase' were not confirmed; page also mentions a discounted student pass, which the article omits.

fact_check.claim: Drivers should override the farebox if your ID is rejected during free hours
fact_check.note: Sun (Nov 2024): drivers instructed to override the farebox. The official Cornell page instead says you may need to pay the $1.50 cash fare if the card is not accepted; the article should note the conflict and that the Sun report is two years old.

fact_check.claim: F-1/J-1 off-campus work needs authorization via CPT/OPT; no more than 20 hours a week in fall and spring
fact_check.note: Page is about applying for an SSN. The 20-hour cap appears in employment-letter guidelines for the SSN letter, not as a rule for off-campus work. The article presents it as the off-campus limit. Needs an official Cornell International Services page on CPT/OPT/economic hardship authorization.

fact_check.claim: Common mistake: more than 20 hours a week when hours include a Cornell job; employers more willing to hire work-study students
fact_check.note: Page gives a 15-20 hour suggestion and overtime above 40 hours; the 'more than 20 hours' warning and 'employers more willing to hire you' are the writer's inference, unsourced.

beats_top.query: ithaca part time jobs for cornell students
beats_top.why: The #1 result is a Cornell Dining on-campus recruitment post with no off-campus guidance; ours is the only one covering Community Work-Study, Ithaca employers and the bus. But our paragraph one is hedged, pay information is thin and one Chamber example is stale.
changes: Add a concrete pay picture with sources: the Valet Supervisor $21-$22 and other dated Chamber pay figures, and New York State minimum wage for upstate with an official link, so 'pay ranges' are actually answered
Replace the stale/unsupported Chamber examples with current dated ones and say 'as of Nov 2026'
Add a short 'what to do this week' section: check Workday work-study eligibility, email cwsp@cornell.edu, browse the Chamber board, with the TCAT route/time caveat

fixes: Remove the 'banquet server and operational staff at the Ithaca Downtown Conference Center' example (the listing is dated 05/13/2025 and shows no pay); replace it with current listings from https://business.tompkinschamber.org/jobs, each with posting month, e.g. Valet Driver at Canopy by Hilton Downtown Ithaca (full-time and part-time, hourly pay plus tips, posted 10/08/2026) and Valet Supervisor ($21-$22 an hour, posted 10/04/2026).

Change 'part-time or flexible roles such as ... a shuttle van driver' so it no longer claims the shuttle van driver (posted 04/22/2026, type not stated) or the Marriott/Fairfield Inn night auditor ($18 an hour, type not stated) are part-time; say only that the Hotel Ithaca night auditor is listed as part-time or full-time, from $16 an hour (posted 10/08/2026), and tell readers to check hours.

Fix the F-1/J-1 bullet: the 20-hours-a-week cap on the cited SSN page comes from the SSN employment letter guidance and is not the off-campus work limit. Remove that claim or replace it with a sourced statement from an official Cornell International Services or USCIS page on off-campus authorization (CPT, OPT, severe economic hardship), linked inline, and keep 'talk to International Services before accepting any offer'.

Change 'searched with your NetID' (FAQ and the Workday mention) to 'log in to Workday with your NetID and password, then search Find Jobs - student', per https://scl.cornell.edu/growth-opportunities/student-employment/students.
Delete or source the sentence 'The page says no information sessions are currently scheduled' (not found on https://einhorn.cornell.edu/?p=407).

Delete 'Your wages are mostly subsidized, so employers are more willing to hire you' and the 'Common mistakes' bullet about more than 20 hours a week (unsourced inference); or restate the sourced rule: 15-20 hours a week suggested, overtime above 40 hours billed to the employer.

In the TCAT section, add that the official Cornell page (https://fcs.cornell.edu/departments/transportation-delivery-services/sustainable-transportation-options/bus-services-privileges-passes) says a discounted pass is available and that if the ID card is not accepted you may need to pay the $1.50 cash fare; label the Sun farebox-override line as a November 2024 report that conflicts with the official page.

Make the Chamber filter sentence match the board: location filters City of Ithaca, Downtown Ithaca BID and Tompkins County, and categories such as Food Industry and Restaurants and Hotel, Gaming, Leisure, and Travel; drop 'event management, non-profit' unless confirmed.

Answer the 'pay ranges' part of the question: add the current New York State minimum wage for upstate/Tompkins County with a link to the NYS Department of Labor, and label the Collegetown/Commons row 'not published; ask the employer' instead of 'Varies'.
